children: Reading International entered into a Contract of Sale to sell its Cinemas 1, 2 & 3 property at 1001–1007 Third Avenue in New York for $41 million to 1001 Third Avenue. A $4.1 million deposit is in escrow, with the balance due at closing, which is not subject to further due diligence or financing contingencies. An existing approximately $19 million mortgage on the property will be repaid at closing. The transaction is expected to close on or about Oct 30, 2026.
